panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: The design doc names this metric cloudmesh_cache_hit_ratio directly, but a ratio has no native Prometheus type. Computed here from the raw cloudmesh_cache_outcomes_total{outcome} counter — see packages/metrics/src/metrics.ts for why a stateful in-process gauge was rejected in favor of this.

options.content:
The design doc's Cache panel also lists **savings** and **popular prompts**, neither of which this metric set tracks, deliberately:

- **Savings** (cost avoided by cache hits) would need a recording rule multiplying hit count by an *estimated* per-request cost, since a hit itself incurs $0 direct provider cost — there's no real number to sum, only a derived estimate. Not built this phase; a reasonable follow-up is a Prometheus recording rule combining `cloudmesh_cache_outcomes_total{outcome="hit"}` with the org's average `cloudmesh_cost_usd_total` per request.
- **Popular prompts** would require prompt text (or a hash of it) as a metric label — a real cardinality and privacy anti-pattern (prompt/response content must never appear in metrics, logs, or trace attributes; see `apps/gateway/src/modules/chat/routes.ts`'s existing `codeql[js/clear-text-logging]` reasoning for the same rule applied to logging). Phase 6's own cache stats (`GET /v1/cache/stats`) already avoid this for the same reason.
